The default ceiling is 15 minutes."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Parameters: `prompt` (required), `mode` (`text` / `keyframe` / `reference`), `seconds` (`"4"`–`"12"`"},{"id":"p31s2","text":", default `"5"`), `size` (`720P`; with `agnes-video-2.5` also `1080P`/`1K`/`2K`), `aspect_ratio` (`1"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"6:9`/`9:16`/`1:1`/`4:3`/`3:4`/`21:9`), `first_frame` / `last_frame` (keyframe mode), `images[]` / `a"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"udios[]` (reference mode), `seed`."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Agnes enforces the per-mode media rules, and this plugin validates them locally before the request, "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"then re-throws the upstream error verbatim. `text` carries no media. `keyframe` needs at least one f"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"rame and no images or audios. `reference` needs at least one image or audio clip and no first or las"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"t frame. AI prompt optimizer"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Both prompt boxes, image and video, have an AI Optimize button.
